chunks: Knowing that He has created you by various stages?

key_terms.أَطْوَارًا: various stages or phases of creation

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'atwar' mean in the context of Surah Noah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of *al-takwin al-tadriji* (gradual creation), linking the physical stages of embryology to the spiritual evolution of the soul under the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the precision of divine design, reminding believers that just as humanity was formed in distinct phases, so too is the cosmic order structured with deliberate wisdom.
